name: io.github.agenttrust-ai/agenttrust
title: AgentTrust — Pre-Invocation AI Agent Trust & Reliability Checks
description: Trust infrastructure for AI agents: a read-only, no-API-key pre-invocation trust check by endpoint URL. Combines agent reliability scoring (when available), endpoint ownership verification, and monitoring history into a machine-readable trustDecision — without contacting the target endpoint.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API_KEY>. Required to call a tool (list_agents, get_agent, get_agent_health, send_heartbeat); tools/list and initialize work without one. Get a key by creating an account at https://getagenttrust.com/signup.
